from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, os, sys, tempfile, json

runtime=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
sys.path.insert(0,str(runtime))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('installed_bridge_session_bootstrap',runtime/'bridge_server.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert getattr(mod.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatWake/0.9-session-bootstrap'
assert callable(getattr(mod,'ensure_session_bootstrap',None))
root=Path(os.environ['PRED_PROJECT_TEMP_ROOT'])/'installed-bootstrap-canary'
for name in ('outbox','inflight','sent','routes'):
    (root/name).mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
mod.base.DATA_DIR=root
mod.base.OUTBOX=root/'outbox'
mod.base.INFLIGHT=root/'inflight'
mod.base.SENT=root/'sent'
mod.base.ROUTES=root/'routes'
mod.base.DEFAULT_CHAT_FILE=root/'default_chat.json'
chat='chat-c-runtimecanary-24'
consumer='tab-runtime-canary-1234'
task=mod.ensure_session_bootstrap(chat,consumer)
assert task and task.startswith('SESSION-ROUTE-')
route=json.loads((mod.base.ROUTES/f'{task}.json').read_text())
assert route['chat_id']==chat and route['consumer_id'] is None
events=list(mod.base.OUTBOX.glob('*.json'))
assert len(events)==1
obj=json.loads(events[0].read_text())
assert obj['task_id']==task and 'kind=SESSION_ROUTE_BOOTSTRAP' in obj['message']
print('INSTALLED_SESSION_BOOTSTRAP_E010=PASS')
print('HANDLER_VERSION='+mod.Handler.server_version)
print('ROUTE_TASK='+task)
